correctness.rationale: Two different complete tour enumerations, all 24 square-face tests versus path-segment inversions, reconstruct 1344 cycles and 1920 edges. BFS from every mobile state proves one component of 1104 plus 240 isolates and exact eccentricities 10:96, 11:192, 12:816 (hence radius 10 and diameter 12). A fully labeled adjacency certificate is independently replayed. Nine orbit vectors are checked under all 384 cube automorphisms. The finite exhaustive proof does not imply higher-dimensional statements.

originality.rationale: The previously known inversion operation, 4-cube count, nine isomorphism types and existence/isolation frequency are expressly excluded as originality claims. The one-component mobility of all 1104 non-isolated cycles and its exact metric/eccentricity spectrum and nine-orbit adjacency vectors are not contained in the inspected prior main texts nor implied by mere Gray-code enumeration or algorithmic reachability from an initial state. Research-record searches returned no equivalent structure. The 2018 table numerics were not readable, limiting priority certainty for isolate count, which is not claimed new.
residual_risks: The 2018 Table 2 numerical cells were not accessible as text and may already include the isolated-state count; that count is not claimed new.

value.rationale: Cyclic Gray codes are a natural Hamilton-cycle configuration space and the face inversion a published local operation. Exact mobility components, all-pairs metric and symmetry adjacency quotient determine whether inversion-only generation can reach all movable codes, and the sharp worst-case number of moves in the first nontrivial cube. Neither a bare code count nor isolation percentage gives these properties.
